399.h: Southwestern University Nigeria is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2012, and it was founded by Babalola Adekunle.
399.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes and is licensed by the National Universities Commission.
399.c: It is located at Okun-Owa, near Ijebu-Ode, in Ogun State.

400.h: Edwin Clark University (ECU) is a private university approved by the Federal Executive Council in 2015. It is named after its founder, Chief Edwin Clark, the elder statesman from Delta State.
400.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes and is licensed by the National Universities Commission.
400.c: It is located in Kiagbodo, Delta State.

401.h: Hezekiah University is a private university licensed by the Federal Government in May 2015.
401.a: The university offers a range of undergraduate programmes and is accredited by the National Universities Commission.
401.c: It is located in Umudi, in the Nkwerre area of Imo State.

402.h: Michael and Cecilia Ibru University (MCIU) is a private university founded in 2015 by the industrialist Michael Ibru and his wife, Cecilia Ibru.
402.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes and is one of the institutions supporting the AltSchool Africa programme, which trains software engineers across the continent.
402.c: It is located in Agbara-Otor, Delta State.

403.h: KolaDaisi University (KDU) is a private university licensed by the National Universities Commission in November 2016, after approval by the Federal Executive Council. It was founded by Chief Kola Daisi, the Bashorun of Ibadan, and its proprietor is the Kola Daisi Foundation.
403.c: It is located in Ibadan, Oyo State.

404.h: Legacy University, Okija is a private university approved through the National Universities Commission. The Commission records its establishment in 2016.
404.c: It is located at Okija, in Ihiala local government area of Anambra State.

405.h: Ojaja University is a private university that began as Crownhill University, founded by Engineer Morgan Akpan. After the institution ran into difficulties it was taken over by new owners and renamed Ojaja University. The National Universities Commission records the original licence in 2016.
405.c: It is located in Eiyenkorin, near Ilorin, Kwara State.

406.h: Coal City University (CCU) is a private, non-profit, co-educational university established in 2016. It takes its name from Enugu's nickname, the Coal City, which comes from the coal mining that shaped the city's history.
406.a: The university has more than 800 students in 10 faculties.
406.c: Its two campuses, at Emene and Independence Layout in Enugu, cover about 432 acres in all.

407.h: Clifford University is a private Christian, co-educational university owned and run by the Seventh-day Adventist Church in Nigeria. It belongs to the Adventist education system, one of the largest Christian school systems in the world. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2016.
407.c: The campus is at Ihie, near Owerrinta, in Abia State.

408.h: Spiritan University, Nneochi is a private Catholic university run by the Congregation of the Holy Spirit (the Spiritans). The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2017.
408.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes and runs an alumni network, Spiritan Alumni Connect, for its graduates.
408.c: It is located in Nneochi, Abia State.

409.h: Atiba University is a private university established in December 2017. It is named after Alaafin Atiba, a nineteenth-century ruler of the Oyo kingdom.
409.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes and is licensed by the National Universities Commission.
409.c: It is located in Oyo town, Oyo State.

410.h: Dominion University, Ibadan is a private university established by Victory International Church, Ibadan, with the aim of providing university education founded on faith and integrity. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2019.
410.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes. Candidates must be at least 16 years old at admission.
410.c: It is located in Ibadan, Oyo State.

411.h: Trinity University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2019.
411.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes and has announced new programmes in biochemistry, logistics management and cybersecurity.
411.c: It is located in Ogun State, south-western Nigeria.

412.h: Westland University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2019.
412.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes, and its Centre for School Innovation and Strategic Studies runs online professional courses for teachers and school administrators.
412.c: It is located in Iwo, Osun State.

413.h: Topfaith University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2021.
413.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes. In the 2025 AD Scientific Index, which measures research output, it was ranked among Nigeria's top ten private universities, and it has an industry partnership with the German electronics company Rohde & Schwarz.
413.c: It is located in Mkpatak, Akwa Ibom State.

414.h: Thomas Adewumi University (TAU) is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2021. Within two years it was hosting events such as the IndabaX machine-learning conference in 2023.
414.c: It is located in Oko-Irese, Kwara State.

415.h: Maranatha University is a private university established in 2021.
415.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes, including international relations and related subjects.
415.c: It is located in Lagos State.

416.h: Ave Maria University, Piyanko (AMU) is a private Catholic university founded by the Ave Maria Foundation, an organisation active in Nigerian education. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2021.
416.c: It is located in Piyanko, Nasarawa State, within reach of Abuja.

417.h: Al-Istiqama University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2021.
417.c: It is located in Sumaila, Kano State.

418.h: Mudiame University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2021.
418.c: It is located in Irrua, Edo State.

419.h: Havilla University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2021.
419.a: The university admits students regardless of race, colour, nationality or ethnic origin, and offers undergraduate programmes.
419.c: It is located in Nde, near Ikom, in Cross River State.

420.h: Claretian University of Nigeria is a private Catholic university run by the Claretian Missionaries. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2021.
420.c: It is located in Nekede, near Owerri, Imo State.

421.h: James Hope University is a private university founded by the business leader Jim Ovia, with support from the Jim Ovia Foundation. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2021.
421.a: The university focuses on business and professional education.
421.c: It is located in Lagos State.

422.h: Maryam Abacha American University of Nigeria (MAAUN) is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2021.
422.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes, including health programmes such as medical laboratory science and a doctor of physiotherapy degree.

423.h: Capital City University is a private university established in 2021, after Federal Government approval in February that year.

424.h: Ahman Pategi University is a private university founded in 2021 by Aliyu Bahago Ahman-Pategi. It aims to widen access to higher education, particularly for students in north-central Nigeria.
424.c: It is located in Pategi, Kwara State.
